nights.title: T.LOVE
nights.name: T.Love
nights.extract: T.Love is a Polish rock band formed in 1982, originally known as Teenage Love Alternative, by Zygmunt "Muniek" Staszczyk, Janusz Konorowski, Dariusz Zając and Jacek Wudecki, all friends from high school in Częstochowa.

en.who: T.Love is a Polish rock band. it was formed in 1982, originally as Teenage Love Alternative, by Zygmunt "Muniek" Staszczyk, Janusz Konorowski, Dariusz Zając and Jacek Wudecki. they were all friends from high school in Częstochowa.
facts: T.Love is a Polish rock band formed in 1982, originally known as Teenage Love Alternative.
Zygmunt "Muniek" Staszczyk, Janusz Konorowski, Dariusz Zając and Jacek Wudecki were all friends from high school in Częstochowa.
